name: Talantis
tagline: Maps internship pipelines between universities and companies, with an AI guide to unexplored talent pools.
problem: Internship outcomes are scattered across posts and group chats, so the patterns stay hidden.
solution: A map of school-to-company pipelines with Atlas, a tool-using agent that compares hiring patterns; the agent is also registered on Agentverse.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask which schools feed a company and find overlooked ones.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Used Figma Make to explore hero, analytics and form designs.

lessons: Aggregated data becomes a product when an agent can answer comparative questions over it.
